about_the_game:
Discover a sneak peek of PLAY AND LEARN: Fun Learning Games for Kids! This demo lets you and your child jump into colorful mini-games, explore early learning skills, and see how fun education can be!

What’s Included in the Demo

MAGIC MATCH – Play the Colors level and help the wizard bring colors to life.

LEAP INTO LEARNING – Try both Uppercase and Lowercase Alphabet adventures, plus practice the Alphabet in learning mode.

MATH-CASTERS – Cast spells with math in Addition (Easy Mode) and sharpen skills using the Practice Calculator.

Demo Limitations

Music Menu is disabled (full soundtrack available in the full game).
Progress Pages are disabled (no saving/tracking).
Extra levels like shapes, numbers, subtraction, sight words, and harder math difficulties are reserved for the full version.

Why Try the Demo?

Perfect for preschool to 1st grade learners.
Simple one-click controls designed for kids.
A safe, fun, and educational sneak peek that shows how learning can feel like play.
